title: Build: forming-vs-closed replay for the US-session legs (alpaca_live ief/slv/iaum_pullback_1d + 11 paper/ib legs) -- the instrument RQ-20261018-2a10-01 could not use
note: Lever filed by research-ops 2026-10-18 14:47Z for PI-20261018-WCDIDFTE-0001. scripts/research/decision_bar_holdout.py replays Binance USD-M 1m klines only, so the 14 legs on _fetch_session_frame (REAL-MONEY alpaca_live ief_pullback_1d / slv_pullback_1d / iaum_pullback_1d) have no closed-vs-forming measurement. Needs: an intraday (1m/5m) session-bar source for the ETF symbols (Alpaca historical bars, keyless path or runner secret) feeding the same boundary/holdout rule as RULE-RQ-20261018-2a10-01; then a pre-registered queue unit. observation.what: a research/queue unit measuring forming-vs-closed for the alpaca_live pullback legs lands a measured record
